card.name: End of drug name before dosage form
card.fires_on: The last piece of a full product name, or the comma or bracket right after it, just before the dosage form or strength (Injection, Capsules, Oral Solution, Tablets, 1%, USP). Seen in label titles and boxed warnings.

modes.label: Salt ending of a drug name
modes.description: Final part of a salt name such as phosphate or bromide, just before the dosage form word.
modes.example: Hydrocodone Bitartrate and Homatropine Methylbrom<<ide>> Oral Solution (Syrup) exposes

modes.label: Punctuation after product name
modes.description: A comma or opening bracket right after 'Injection', leading into strength or USP.

card.writes: It seems to push toward label-style terms such as US/USP and ingredients that follow a product name.
card.plain: It lights up when a full drug product name is just finishing and the form, such as tablets or injection, comes next.
